summary: Ares Capital Corporation filed an 8-K announcing entry into equity distribution agreements with five sales agents to sell up to $1.5 billion of its common stock at-the-market under a prior shelf registration. The filing is a routine at-the-market offering program setup, not a special situation transaction. No specific terms such as price per share, premium, or closing date are stated; sales are discretionary based on market conditions. The agents receive up to 1.5% commission. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity beyond customary representations is noted. This is an ordinary capital-raising facility, not a transformative event.
